summary: Customer handles a petroleum stream, currently uses laboratory water determination, and wants to investigate a fiber-based measurement closer to the process so changes are noticed sooner, with the analyzer outside the process area. They ask what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish before selecting equipment.

facts_stated.text: We currently send samples to a laboratory for water determination.

facts_stated.text: We want to investigate a fiber based measurement closer to the process.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We want to investigate a fiber based measurement closer to the process

facts_stated.text: The motivation is that changes can be noticed sooner.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: so that changes can be noticed sooner

facts_stated.text: The analyzer would be outside the process area.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The analyzer would be outside the process area

facts_stated.text: Before selecting equipment, they need to know what to clarify and what a first comparison experiment should establish.

customer_premises.claim: A fiber-based measurement closer to the process will make changes noticeable sooner.

customer_premises.claim: The analyzer can be outside the process area while still measuring the process stream.

customer_premises.claim: A first comparison experiment can establish what is needed before selecting equipment.
